features.text: PDAC APPROVED L4396: Prefabricated, custom-fitted orthosis for mild to moderate contractures and foot drop.
BEND-TO-FIT CONSTRUCTION: Easily molds to the patient’s foot and ankle shape for optimal therapeutic alignment.
DYNAMIC DORSIFLEXION SUPPORT: Provides consistent stretching for plantar flexion, inversion, and eversion contractures.
MEDIOLATERAL STABILIZATION: Enhances balance and alignment during ambulation or seated therapy.
SOFT PADDED INTERIOR: Cushioned fabric protects sensitive skin and improves comfort during extended wear.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
